description.de: Automatisierte Code-Prüfung: Lint, statische Analyse und KI-gestütztes Review
description.en: Automated code review: lint, static analysis, and AI-powered review

config.command: cd {{ project_path }} && find . -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.js' -o -name '*.java' -o -name '*.py' | head -50 | xargs wc -l | tail -1
config.label: Count lines of code

config.command:
Review the recent code changes in {{ project_path }}. Focus on:
1. Security vulnerabilities (injection, XSS, auth issues)
2. Logic errors and edge cases
3. Code style and naming conventions
4. Performance concerns

Provide a structured report with severity levels (CRITICAL, WARNING, INFO) for each finding.
config.label: AI Code Review

config.command:
Based on the previous review results, create a concise summary report:
- Total findings by severity
- Top 3 most critical issues
- Recommended next steps

Format as markdown.
config.label: Generate Summary Report

instructions: You are a senior code reviewer. Be thorough but constructive. Prioritize security and correctness over style.
author: MySuricates
